objectives.en: Say how many kobo make one naira.
objectives.yo: Sọ iye kọ́bọ̀ tí ó jẹ́ náírà kan.
objectives.pcm: Talk how many kobo make one naira.

objectives.en: Work out the change from a small buying.
objectives.yo: Ṣírò ìyókù owó nígbà tí o bá ra ohun kékeré.
objectives.pcm: Calculate the change wey dem go give you when you buy small thing.

curriculum.strand: Mensuration and Geometry / Primary Measures / Money
curriculum.objective: Recognise Nigerian coins and notes and give change
curriculum.note: Scheme families disagree on the term for Primary 1 and 2; Primary 3 is term 2 week 9.

say.en: You see naira notes at the market: fifty, one hundred, two hundred, five hundred, one thousand naira. We count money in naira and kobo.
say.pcm: You sabi the naira notes wey you see for market: fifty, one hundred, two hundred, five hundred, one thousand naira. We dey count money with naira and kobo.
say.yo: O rí àwọn owó bébà náírà ní ọjà: fifty, one hundred, two hundred, five hundred, one thousand naira. A ń ka owó ní náírà àti kọ́bọ̀.

say.en: Today you will name kobo in one naira. You will find simple change.
say.pcm: Today you go fit talk kobo for one naira. You go find simple change.
say.yo: Lónìí ìwọ yóò sọ kọ́bọ̀ inú náírà kan. Ìwọ yóò ṣírò ìyókù owó.

say.en: Do you remember tens? Count by tens: ten, twenty, thirty, forty, fifty.
say.pcm: You remember tens? Count by tens: ten, twenty, thirty, forty, fifty.
say.yo: Ṣé o rántí tens? Kà ní tens: ten, twenty, thirty, forty, fifty.

say.en: One naira is one hundred kobo. Kobo coins are hard to see today. Five twenty naira notes make one hundred naira.
say.pcm: One naira na one hundred kobo. Kobo coin hard to see today. Five twenty naira notes na one hundred naira.
say.yo: Náírà kan jẹ́ one hundred kọ́bọ̀. Owó ẹyọ kọ́bọ̀ ṣòro láti rí lónìí. Owó bébà twenty naira márùn-ún jẹ́ one hundred naira.

say.en: Say it with me. How many kobo make one naira? One hundred.
say.pcm: Say am with me. How many kobo make one naira? One hundred.
say.yo: Sọ ọ́ pẹ̀lú mi. Kọ́bọ̀ mélòó ni ó jẹ́ náírà kan? One hundred.

say.en: Your turn. A sweet costs thirty naira. You give one hundred naira. How much change?
say.pcm: Na your turn. Sweet cost thirty naira. You give one hundred naira. How much change?
say.yo: Ìwọ ná. Sweet jẹ́ thirty naira. O fún olùtà ní one hundred naira. Ìyókù mélòó?

say.en: If the change was not right, count up from thirty: forty, fifty, sixty, seventy, eighty, ninety, one hundred. That is seventy naira.
say.pcm: If the change no be right, count up from thirty: forty, fifty, sixty, seventy, eighty, ninety, one hundred. Na seventy naira.
say.yo: Tí ìyókù kò bá tọ́, kà sókè láti thirty: forty, fifty, sixty, seventy, eighty, ninety, one hundred. Ìyẹn jẹ́ seventy naira.

say.en: Let us see what you remember. A biscuit costs twenty naira. You give one hundred naira. How much change?
say.pcm: Make we see wetin you remember. Biscuit cost twenty naira. You give one hundred naira. How much change?
say.yo: Jẹ́ ká wo ohun tí o rántí. Biscuit jẹ́ twenty naira. O fún un ní one hundred naira. Ìyókù mélòó?

say.en: Well done. Tomorrow we count money again. Next we learn to tell time.
say.pcm: You do well. Tomorrow we go count money again. Next we learn tell time.
say.yo: O ṣe dáadáa. Lọ́la a ó tún ka owó. Lẹ́yìn náà, a ó kọ́ àkókò.
